# Python dependencies of the probes under probes/.
#
# Pins reflect what was actually used during the campaign, as recorded in
# docs/campaigns/01-verification.fr.md ("astrapy 2.3.1 ; cassandra-driver 3.30.1 ;
# Python 3.12.3") and in data/raw/cmp_mongo.json -> conditions.python ("3.12.3").
#
# Interpreter: Python 3.12.3.
#
#   python3 -m venv .venv && . .venv/bin/activate
#   pip install -r env/requirements.txt

# Data API client. astrapy 2.3.1 is the version in which the self-hosted-HCD
# gotcha documented in REPRODUCING.md was observed: without
# environment=Environment.HCD the client targets Astra's /api/json/v1 prefix and
# every command returns HTTP 404 against a self-hosted Data API, which serves /v1.
astrapy==2.3.1

# CQL driver, used by the probes that read system_schema, system_traces and the
# shredded rows directly, and by the native-CQL aggregation arm.
cassandra-driver==3.30.1

# MongoDB driver.
# NOT PINNED, and the omission is deliberate: no file under data/raw/ and no
# campaign report records the pymongo version that was installed. Pinning a
# version here would be an invented fact. Record the version you install
# (pip freeze) alongside any figure you publish, as the campaign should have done.
pymongo
